summary.text: Mike Kelley is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 60 since 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mike Kelley earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Oklahoma, and Ballotpedia lists firefighter as his career experience.
He won the 2024 Republican primary runoff for the open District 60 seat over Ron Lynch on August 27, 2024, and took office on November 20, 2024, succeeding Rhonda Baker.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Government Oversight Committee.
He defeated Kade Renfro in the June 16, 2026 Republican primary and faces Sharon Taylor, a Democrat, in the general election.
